verdict.rationale: Dialpad's own llms.txt lists a first-party page on 'Dialpad's Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for connecting Dialpad with AI tools and agents', which indicates an official MCP integration path for agents. The evidence is only that single index-level mention, with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server endpoint or install method, the exposed tools/resources, authentication setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can connect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
